title: fix(cli)!: orphans --delete without --yes in a non-interactive shell exits 1
body:
Fixes #36331
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under skills/** teaches `os db orphans` / `os secret orphans` or their exit status (grep for orphans over skills/: 0 hits); the CLI reference page content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx was re-read and states nothing the change falsifies

## 维护者速读

- 运维在脚本、CI 或定时任务里运行两个清理孤儿数据的命令且未加确认参数时,以前显示「已中止」并返回成功,现在返回失败并提示加确认参数;交互式回答「否」照旧返回成功。
- 为什么做:与数据库迁移命令族已定的规则对齐,避免脚本把什么都没删的一次运行当成成功。
- 出错会怎样:只改未确认时的退出码与提示文字,删除与导出的内容不变;依赖旧退出码的脚本需加确认参数,出问题可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无。

## Breaking

**BREAKING** (an exit status narrows), shipped as `patch`: the change is not to the metadata protocol (`Metadata-protocol: none`), so the level axis grades `patch`. The precedent `os migrate apply` (62bc129 in `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md`) shipped `minor` under the launch-window convention, which the level axis in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` has since replaced: a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition.

- **FROM:** `os db orphans --delete --export PATH` or `os secret orphans --delete --export PATH` on a database with rows to delete, without `--yes`, with stdin not a terminal, text face: nothing exported or deleted, `Aborted — …`, exit `0`.
- **TO:** nothing exported or deleted, `Confirmation required. Re-run with --yes to delete. No export was written and no row was deleted.`, exit `1`.
- **Unchanged:** answering `n` at the `[y/N]` prompt in a terminal still prints `Aborted — …` and exits `0`; `--json` without `--yes` already exited `1` with `confirmation_required`; a run with `--yes` deletes as before; a run with nothing to delete exits `0` without asking.
- **The fix for a script:** pass `--yes` to delete; drop `--delete` to get only the report.

ADR-0087 disposition: the changeset carries the marker `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; no metadata, stored shape or export moves, and the remedy is a flag on the caller's command line. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` at ca5b49ee: `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition` (`[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]`).

## What changes

`os db orphans --delete` and `os secret orphans --delete`, run where stdin is not a terminal and without `--yes`, now print `Confirmation required. Re-run with --yes to delete. No export was written and no row was deleted.` and exit 1. Before, the text face printed `Aborted — …` and exited 0 (the `--json` face already exited 1 with `confirmation_required`).

The shape is the `os migrate` family's (`migrate/apply.ts`: a non-TTY run without `--yes` warns naming `--yes`, then `this.exit(1)`). An interactive `n` keeps exit 0 and the `Aborted — …` line, as the family's decline does (the migrate pin's control case). Nothing about what either command deletes or exports changes; on this path nothing is exported or deleted, as before.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/cli/src/commands/secret/orphans.ts` — the new non-TTY branch inside the `!flags.yes` gate; the `this.exit(1)` sits inside the `try` whose `catch` already rethrows the exit signal (`isExitSignal`).
2. `packages/cli/src/commands/db/orphans.ts` — the same branch, same `try`/`catch` shape.
3. `packages/cli/test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` — the sibling pin.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` — expect 9 passed.

## Tests

New sibling pin `packages/cli/test/orphans-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` (unit tier; boot replaced via `vi.mock`, never value-imported). The migrate pin's roster reads `src/commands/migrate/**` only; this one discovers every non-migrate command module whose class declares a boolean `delete` flag and a boolean `yes` flag, and its first case holds that population equal to the roster (`db orphans`, `secret orphans`).

Per member: text face non-TTY without `--yes` (exit 1, output names `--yes`, no delete reached, no export file, no prompt); `--json` face (exit 1, `confirmation_required`); control `--yes` (exit 0, one delete, export written); control terminal answered `n` (prompted, exit 0, nothing deleted, no export).

Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; both files' hashes equal their HEAD blobs and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tests import the command modules from `src/` (no `dist/` in the path), so no rebuild leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `os secret rewrap --apply` has the same shape (`packages/cli/src/commands/secret/rewrap.ts`, the `!flags.yes` gate: text face `Aborted — no row was opened or written.` and exit 0 when stdin is no TTY). It is outside this card's file surface and its pin's population (no `delete` flag), so it is not touched here; it is reported to the seat for a card.
- CLI `unit` tier, full run: 437/439 files passed; the two failures (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refuse because `packages/cli` is not built in this worktree, a prerequisite, not a verdict. The `integration` tier is declared to CI.

## Verification

Local derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 70): 64 exit 0; 5 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so NOT MEASURED: `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity` need the built CLI; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full build; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallowed clone); `check:test-source-alias` red on an intermediate head and green at 4cb78e09 after the fix. Re-run at 4cb78e09: `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:cli-test-child-env`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cli-command-ids`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 70 derived, 70 run, 0 unrun. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0 (8d0d1c86; the later commits change test mocks only, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` is clean for the pin file at 4cb78e09).

Dogfood battery, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm, at ca5b49ee (the changeset-only head; the code is unchanged since 4cb78e09): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock after building its dependency closure. Result: Test Files 487 passed, 3 skipped (490); Tests 4121 passed, 68 skipped (4189); VERDICT command-exit 0, with no failures.

Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (`os db orphans`, `os secret orphans`) was re-read. It says nothing about the exit status of a run whose confirmation was refused (`-y, --yes` is described as skipping the prompt, which stays true), so it is unchanged.
